messages:
Alice Chen: Heads up — over the last 3h we saw repeated client reconnect waves from EU edge. Pattern: single SSE read timeout -> client reconnects with zero jitter -> downstream quota spike and billing blip.
Marco Ruiz: yep saw that, dashboards show ~4x normal resume attempts for a few minutes. looks correlated with proxy read-timeouts hitting the 30s mark.
Lina Patel: repro logs:
```
proxy: read timeout 30000ms for session=abc123 edge=eu1
client: got EOF, reconnecting
api: resume-request route=/v1/stream model=redwood-small
```
Clients are immediately opening new streams; no backoff.
Jordan W.: Are clients respecting Retry-After or backoff? we don't inject any soft-jitter on reconnect in our SDK by default.
Priya (oncall): Oncall ran rule — quota burn is high enough to push a few customers into emergency throttles. If this is a common transient we risk SLA page. Suggest server-side mitigation first.
Alice Chen: Proposal: add a short server-side grace window for read timeouts where we return a soft close + hint header instead of hard EOF. Idea: proxy returns 498 (soft-timeout) with header `X-SSE-DRain: retry-after=1500;reason=read_timeout` so SDK can jitter. Also tag telemetry with reconnect_reason=soft_timeout.
Marco Ruiz: Alternative: bump proxy read timeout to 60s for EU for next 24h while we roll, but that hides real issue and increases cost. I prefer graceful hint.
Lina Patel: Minimal config patch to test:
```
edge.proxy.sse.soft_close.enabled = true
edge.proxy.sse.soft_close.retry_after_ms = 1500
edge.proxy.sse.read_timeout_ms = 30000
```
If enabled, proxy will send `event: _soft_close\ndata: {"retry_after_ms":1500, "reason":"read_timeout"}\n\n` before closing.
Jordan W.: Love the event-based soft-close. Needs SDK support to interpret `_soft_close` and apply jitter/backoff. I'll open an SDK PR to auto-jitter 1500-3000ms and exponential backoff after 3 attempts.
Priya (oncall): Make sure we tag console traces with `reconnect_hint=soft_close` and `reconnect_reason=read_timeout`. We need to surface this in per-route charts so SRE/product can see how many reconnections were hinted vs forced.
devops-bot: deploy queued for branch soft-close/feature-flag (CI: passed, staging: success) :rocket:
Marco Ruiz: Also add a telemetry tag `client_applied_backoff=true/false` so we can measure SDK adoption. If clients don't adopt, fallback to server-side rate-limiter that applies small delayed-accepts for the same client IP.
Lina Patel: I'll draft the proxy change today, can we gate behind feature-flag `sse_soft_close` and roll 10% -> 50% -> 100%? Need console rollout UX: a per-route toggle + histogram of hinted reconns.
Alice Chen: Agreed. Action items:
- Lina: PR for proxy soft-close + feature flag + telemetry tags (reconnect_hint, reconnect_reason)
- Jordan: SDK PR to handle `_soft_close` event & jitter/backoff + metric `client_applied_backoff`
- Priya: Add alert tweak to ignore transient hinted reconnections until 15m sustained
- Marco: monitoring dashboard change: show hinted vs forced reconns and quota burn per minute
If we get this in staging and see client_applied_backoff > 50% then roll.
Jordan W.: I'll link the SDK PR in this thread when ready.
Lina Patel: starting work — will paste config diff + logs from staging once deployed.
Priya (oncall): thanks — please ping #incidents if quota burn spikes while testing.
Alice Chen: :thumbsup:
